title: Airports have different delay risks
hook: Two stated cases: explore the airport composition behind on-time rates.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the airport composition behind on-time rates affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the airport composition behind on-time rates in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
